title: Count Pairs with Given Difference
statement:
Given an array of distinct integers and a non-negative integer K, count the number of unique pairs (a, b) such that |a - b| = K.

A pair (a, b) and (b, a) count as the same pair. Report each unordered pair once.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^5
-10^6 <= A[i] <= 10^6
All elements are distinct.
0 <= K <= 10^6
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated distinct integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of unique unordered pairs with absolute difference K.
